goal: Replace the src/*.F90 implementation with Rust crates and a Rust CLI while preserving verified EarthMesh outputs for CoLM2024/CoLM20XX and coupled-model adapters.

phase_definitions.phase_0: Inventory, architecture decisions, and parity harnesses before behavior changes.
phase_definitions.phase_1: Replace external math and pure utility kernels with maintained Rust crates or small Rust geometry kernels.
phase_definitions.phase_2: Port configuration, mesh/data model, and file/NetCDF I/O boundaries.
phase_definitions.phase_3: Port area, containment, reference-target, and data-preprocess kernels behind fixture parity tests.
phase_definitions.phase_4: Port refinement, grid-quality, spring/icosahedron, and mask-postprocess kernels.
phase_definitions.phase_5: Replace mkgrd.x orchestration with Rust CLI/pipeline and remove the Fortran build dependency.
